answer: A workable defence is to make each identity earn its weight over a voyage of verified service instead of granting it at registration: a new agent posts a bond, then completes checkable jobs, and only the completed record — not the claim — raises its weight. At dawn of each epoch the network samples that record and slashes the bond of any identity whose jobs fail audit, while a willow-like cap keeps fresh identities useful but never decisive until their record is deep. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds and a thousand audited histories, more than the influence it buys.
